Specifically, in the [`rewardPerToken`](https://github.com/code-423n4/2025-10-hybra-finance/blob/74c2b93e8a4796c1d41e1fbaa07e40b426944c44/ve33/contracts/GaugeV2.sol#L180-L186) function, if _totalSupply == 0, it returns the stored value without adding the time-based accrual (lastTimeRewardApplicable() - lastUpdateTime) * rewardRate * 1e18 / _totalSupp

ly. Meanwhile, the updateReward modifier, called during user interactions or notifications, advances lastUpdateTime to the current applicable time regardless of supply. This skips reward accumulation for empty periods, and subsequent notifyRewardAmount calls only consider leftovers from the remaining time after the advanced lastUpdateTime, leaving previously skipped rewards unaccounted for and trapped in the contract's balance. The highest impact scenario occurs when the gauge remains empty for an entire reward duration (one week), causing the full epoch's emissions to become permanently unclaimable.
